title: Revit Working Library - Views

entries.name: Floor Plan - Coordination
graphics_guidance: existing context may be halftoned while new work remains visually dominant
linked models visible by discipline where required
rule-based filters may identify coordination or clearance zones

entries.name: Floor Plan - Documentation
graphics_guidance: fine detail may be required for components whose documentation depends on it
phase appearance should be controlled through the template rather than ad-hoc overrides

entries.name: Reflected Ceiling Plan - Documentation
graphics_guidance: cut plane optimized for ceiling documentation
lighting and building-services categories may be emphasized through governed filters

entries.name: Section - Documentation
graphics_guidance: cut elements may use poche or material cut patterns
medium detail may be acceptable where fine geometry adds no documentation value

entries.name: 3D - Coordination
graphics_guidance: category color coding may be driven by filters
section box may be enabled for bounded coordination review

working_rules: Use view templates to centralize repeatable graphics and visibility behavior.
Prefer category visibility and rule-based filters over element-level overrides.
Treat manual element overrides as temporary or exceptional unless separately governed.
Working and published views should be distinguishable by governed purpose or status rather than informal naming alone.
Phasing, design options, and workset visibility remain project/configuration-dependent where no approved enterprise value exists.

provenance.migration_note: Useful view-purpose and template examples retained as non-authoritative working data. Organization/client/project identifiers removed.
